candidates.title: Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization
candidates.reason: OptR targets the post-attention output error that matters to the model while preserving paged KV-cache layout, directly extending ultra-low-bit KV-cache quantization and efficient decoding lineages.

candidates.title: Asymmetric KV Cache Compression Using State-Aware Sparsity and Quantization
candidates.reason: The method jointly exploits Key/Value structural asymmetry, sparsity and quantization under variable request lengths, directly extending KV-cache compression and resource-constrained inference lineages.

candidates.title: DynaCalKV: Key-Value Cache Compression via Head Grouping and Adaptive Rank Allocation
candidates.reason: DynaCalKV combines dynamic attention-head grouping with adaptive low-rank allocation, directly updating low-rank and head-aware KV-cache compression lineages.

candidates.title: LOCKS: Page-Local Compact Key Summaries for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
candidates.reason: LOCKS uses page-local spectral summaries to avoid full KV-cache reads during long-context decoding and integrates with vLLM, directly extending sparse attention, paged-cache and long-context serving lineages.

candidates.title: HiKV: Hierarchical Importance-Aware KV Cache with Hardware Acceleration for LLM Decoding
candidates.reason: HiKV combines two-granularity importance-aware KV compression with dedicated hardware acceleration, directly extending hierarchical KV-cache compression and decoding acceleration lineages.
